UX-587: test_docs_links_and_commands.py is set to 18.4 from run 33746724625's test (3.11) candidate (head b3ed6e4, shift x1.07), replacing 9.96. This guard's cost IS the size of the backlog it walks, so its entry goes stale as rows are filed and never comes back: measured on one tree, 584 task files read 13.00s and 286 read 7.47s, a slope of 0.0185 s/file that puts the guard at 9.5s at the 397 files UX-488 re-recorded from - against the 9.96 recorded. The gate confirmed it over two consecutive runs and was right to. --adopt cannot correct this: it adds names the reference lacks and rewrites no entry it has (ci.yml:351), by design, so an entry for a growing population is refreshed by a round or not at all.
